en.t: First he had to climb onto the roof.

units.source_text: 抛东西时仰角接近四十五度效率最好。

en.t: When throwing something, an angle of nearly forty-five degrees was the most efficient.

units.source_text: 其实，他想用绳索试试登上屋顶的角度

en.t: Actually, he wanted to use the rope to test the angle for getting up onto the roof

units.source_text: 又生怕剪刀碰到屋顶的声音会把女人给吵醒。

en.t: but he was afraid the sound of the scissors striking the roof would wake the woman.

units.source_text: 于是他省去了实验，绕到了背面，

en.t: So he skipped the experiment and went around to the back,

units.source_text: 把以前晾晒什么东西的雨棚残骸当做立脚点，爬了上去。

en.t: using the remains of an awning where something had once been dried as a foothold, and climbed up.

units.source_text: 细细的木材已经有一半腐烂了，着实令他担心了一阵。

en.t: The thin wood was already half rotten, which made him genuinely uneasy for a while.

units.source_text: 谁知更令人担心的还在后头呢。

en.t: But something even more worrying was still ahead.

units.source_text: 被飞沙磨光了的屋顶，像没有铺东西似的，

en.t: The roof, polished smooth by flying sand, looked as if nothing had been laid over it,

units.source_text: 白白的木纹显露得清清楚楚，

en.t: and the pale grain of the wood showed with perfect clarity,

units.source_text: 刚一踩上去，嘎吱嘎吱，软乎乎的，像回潮的饼干。

en.t: the moment he stepped on it, it creaked and gave softly, like a damp biscuit.
One careless move and his foot would go right through.

units.source_text: 他赶快趴下，分散体重，慢慢地向前爬行。

en.t: He quickly lay flat, spread out his weight, and slowly crawled forward.

units.source_text: 总算爬到了房梁，他以骑跨的姿势，膝盖顶着站了起来。

en.t: At last he reached a beam, and, straddling it, braced himself with his knees and stood up.

units.source_text: 屋顶也已笼罩在阴影中，

en.t: The roof too was already covered in shadow,

units.source_text: 西面洞穴的边缘腾起了结冻的小颗粒，淡淡的蜂蜜色，

en.t: and along the western edge of the pit, frozen little particles were rising, a faint honey color,

units.source_text: 这可是将要出现薄雾的标志。

en.t: which was a sign that a thin mist was about to appear.

units.source_text: 再也没有必要去顾忌瞭望哨了。

en.t: There was no longer any need to worry about the lookout post.
